name: Virag Packaging Library
principles: Default to a 4:5 Instagram launch or information creative showcasing the packaging work unless Native Tool Output is selected.
Change only packaging elements authorized by the current request and preserve all protected brand facts.
Use a clear information grid and real readable type; reject generic mockups and AI label text.
Every output is separate and uses a genuinely different design direction.

DESIGN-SYSTEM LOCK: Obey the selected Design Direction. Auto Fresh must assign every requested output a different compatible design family and must change the grid skeleton, crop, product placement, type architecture, information-module design, graphic devices, palette and texture—not merely the background. Use the supplied reference principles without copying any brand, artwork, composition or text.

PRODUCT FIDELITY: Pixel-Locked Composite remains the default. Alter packaging only when Product Fidelity is explicitly set to Authorized Packaging Redesign and the current request specifies what may change. Otherwise use the exact uploaded product cutout unchanged and reject every geometry, label or color deviation.
